incidents.name: NeverFall price manipulation
incidents.notes: The NeverFall contract sizes its USDT payout from the live pool reserves it reads, so a flash loan moved that price and let the attacker redeem far more USDT than deposited.

sources.ref: onchain review: NeverFall 0x5ABDe8B434133C98c36F4B21476791D95D888bF5 created 2023-03-17T03:41:41Z by 0x051d6a5f987e4fc53b458ec4f88a104356e6995a, unrelated to attack sender 0x53b757db8b9f3375d71eafe53e411a16acde75ee; no EIP-1967 Upgraded events, age measured from deployment. Loss verified onchain: the attacker netted 74,250.89 USDT after repaying the flash loan. Boundary row: the victim behaved as coded and the attacker moved the price it read.
